name: Diner — Scan QR code and browse menu items
description: A diner scans a venue QR code, arrives at the table menu, views available dishes, and filters by category.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the venue scan page at /scan?outlet_id=demo-outlet&table=4
Scroll down through the dish rail to browse available menu items
Click on a category filter tab such as Mains or Drinks
Verify the venue welcome header displays the restaurant name and table number, and the dish list displays prices formatted in whole Naira (e.g. ₦4,500)
